high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website "thehindubusinessline.com." The article discusses the government's initiative to declare 2022-23 as the Year of Enterprises in Kerala, India. The goal was to create at least one lakh (100,000) new enterprises and generate 3 to 4 lakh jobs. This project was launched by the Department of Industries & Commerce (DI&C) with cooperation from various departments including Local Administration, Co-operation, Fisheries, and Animal Husbandry.
